items.title: Why Nvidia's purchase of Hugging Face is an 'important strategic move'
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) will be buying open-weight AI company Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley and BD8 Capital Partners, LLC CEO Barbara Doran to discuss what this means for Nvidia's standing in the AI ecosystem as it aims to become more than just a chip supplier.

items.title: AVGO Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Rise on Strong AI Demand
items.summary: Broadcom's fiscal Q3 earnings and revenues beat estimates as AI chip demand surges, with AI semiconductor sales up 221% and a higher fiscal 2026 outlook.

items.title: Wall Street Nears Record Highs With Help From Mag 7
items.summary: Stocks rallied during Thursday's session, nearing record levels, with some help from the Magnificent Seven.  The Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF was up 2.7% to $70.58, just a stone's throw from its record closing price of $70.94.  The Nasdaq was up 1.4% while the S&P 500 rose 1%.
